query-mapping.description: Stats for the tests executed in builds

query.name: report-build-metrics
query.comment: The build metrics for a given metric kind
query.sql: SELECT build.id AS build_id, build.number AS build_number, build.create_date AS build_date, build.status AS build_status, metric.name, mb.value AS value FROM porion_build AS build INNER JOIN porion_build_metric as mb ON mb.build_id = build.id INNER JOIN porion_metric AS metric ON mb.metric_id = metric.id AND metric.metric = :metric WHERE build.project_id = :project_id
